correctness.rationale: The poset order is reconstructed from multiplication and the radical filtration; corner scalars factor through any middle point, while diagonal conjugation realizes every double monomial action. The projective alphabet and cyclic/inversion action give exact rotation/reflection cycle decompositions in both parities of q−1, and Burnside counts all multisets. Rank 0/1/2 exhaust the possibilities. Program verify.py replays 23 independent small-parameter checks including full actual-matrix orbits; no infinite claim rests on finite computation.

value.rationale: The canonical square of the Jacobson radical is an intrinsic Loewy-layer invariant of the three-level incidence algebra. The exact orbit generating function and rank stratification classify algebra elements up to their true automorphism symmetries uniformly in q,t and show surprising independence from the middle antichain size s. These are motivated structural arithmetic invariants of an unbounded algebra family rather than a choice of arbitrary examples.
